description: Get AI-recommended domain suggestions for a keyword or theme (e.g. "tom", "crypto", "defi"). Returns creative name + TLD combos with a category, each cross-checked for availability, priced, and given a register link. Use when a user asks "suggest names", "find me a domain about X", or "give me some .xrp ideas".

query.description: Keyword or theme to base suggestions on, e.g. "tom" or "crypto".

tlds.description: TLDs to include (without dots), e.g. ["xrp","xrpfi"]. Omit for all.

name: recommend_domain
